style: Epic painterly fantasy card illustration, highly detailed, cinematic composition, dramatic rim lighting and deep shadows, rich cosmic colour.
race: The Aureline, exactly as in the reference images: tall, slender, solemn beings with smooth pale grey alien skin, an elongated smooth bald head with one single large cyclopean eye that holds a starfield, a narrow lipless face, long thin fingers, a glowing golden halo ring floating around the head or neck, flowing ivory-white robes or gold-trimmed white-and-gold plate armour with fine gold embroidery. They carry sun-staffs (a twisted golden staff cradling a small blazing sun in a cage of golden rings) or sun-lances (long white-and-gold lances tipped with a leaf-shaped blade of solid golden light). Every Aureline is an individual: vary build, height, head shape, eye colour, robes, armour and markings.
framing: Wide 16:9 landscape. Leave clear sky or background across the top quarter of the picture; the main figure's head sits about 40% of the way down and a little to one side of centre, never at the very top. No text, no lettering, no borders, no letterbox bars, no frame.

cards.helio_lancer: Aureline Lancer, in battle. An Aureline lancer in white-and-gold plate armour and a crimson cape lunges from the left across a scorched, burning plain at dusk, driving a sun-lance into the glowing core of a Xel'Naru warrior: a hulking figure built of hovering rose-pink crystal shards around a core of white light. Crystal shards and golden sparks burst from the impact. Smoke columns and distant fires on the horizon, a low orange sun behind, other lancers and crystal warriors clashing far off in the haze.
cards.ignition_protocol: Sol-Marshal Aurex, the Aureline war-marshal, leaps from the prow of a charging Aureline sun-barque (a sleek ship of white metal and gold carrying a captive blazing sun between two tall pylons) down toward a burning enemy world below. Aurex, in ornate gold armour with a sunburst crown and a streaming red cape, has a sun-lance levelled for the strike. Behind him the barque's engines flare; around him streaks of fire, enemy beams lancing up from the planet, debris and other barques diving in formation.
cards.aureline_sun_priest: The Aureline Sun-Priest at worship. A robed Aureline priest in ivory and gold, with a red stole, stands at the top of a great white stone stair, sun-staff raised high toward an enormous rising sun that fills the sky. Rows of kneeling Aureline faithful in white robes line the steps below, heads bowed, their halos glowing. Shafts of golden light pour down the stair through incense smoke, between colossal temple columns.
cards.halo_ward: A Halo Warden protecting a Stellari bloom. On a dead, ruined grey world under a dark starry sky with a pale moon, an Aureline warden in pale blue-and-silver armour kneels over a single luminous white flower (the Stellari: twelve long translucent petals glowing from within) growing from the cracked ground among broken columns. The warden holds up a round shield of blue hard light, and a dome of shimmering light arches over the flower as falling crystal shards shatter against it.
cards.aurelia_first_light: Aurelia, the First Light, the first Aureline, at the dawn of time. A tall, ancient and serene Aureline in radiant white robes, a delicate golden circlet and a brilliant golden halo, cradles the Infinite Stellari (a great white flower of long glowing translucent petals) in her long-fingered hands. Its light is the first light in the universe and pours out across a newborn cosmos: swirling nebulae, young stars igniting, galaxies forming behind her. Reverent, quiet, awe-inspiring.
